status: FROZEN on 2026-11-06, before any refinement ran on a test-split target. Not to be changed after seeing test results.
chosen_on: YCB-V dev_subset (scenes 50, 58, 59), detector masks, clean plus six corrupted conditions
why: Depth alone beat every combination with silhouette or color on dev.
Silhouette alone drifts along the camera ray (16.5 mm along the ray, 3.1 mm sideways).
Color alone hurts (ADD-S AUC -2.70), and a low color weight adds nothing reliable over depth alone.
sigma 3 mm with 30 steps matched the 60-step default on ADD-S and ADD, was slightly better on MSPD, and ran in half the time.

Rule set in advance: keep depth-only unless it does significant harm under a corruption where an alternative does not. It did no significant harm under any of the six (results/tables/dev_corruption_check.csv).
